description: You might need to grab some shades for this one! 😎 The Perry Kramer PK Ripper 27.5” Looptail is straight-up blingin’. This is BMX legend Perry Kramer’s signature bike, and it features a high-polish frame, chrome forks, chrome bars, and chrome pads that shine from every angle, with blue accents that set it off perfectly. This year we stepped it up with eyeleted rims for added strength, so the wheels are built to handle the ride and look dialed. For stopping power, we upgraded the hydraulic disc brakes to Shimano MT200’s front and rear. Up front you’ll find the Scot Enterprises stem, paying tribute to BMX pioneer Scot Breithaupt—the man who created SE in 1977. This bike also comes stock with genuine Oakley B-1B grips made in the USA, something you don’t see every day. The 27.5” PK Ripper Looptail is on point—who’s ready to ride? This, and all SE bikes are now only available at select SE dealers and online retailers, so don’t miss out!
